name: Cube CLI
description: Remote control for the CubeSandbox control plane: sandbox lifecycle, ports and files.
whenToUse: Create, list, inspect, pause, resume, snapshot or delete a CubeSandbox; run commands or code inside a sandbox; upload and download files; debug control-plane connectivity.

items.name: guide
items.description: Cube CLI 完整使用手册与沙箱控制面工作流指引

secretBindings.label: CubeSandbox API Key
secretBindings.hint: CubeSandbox 控制面 API 访问密钥

tools.name: cube_ping
tools.description: Zero-dependency bridge probe: returns { ok, pid, bootAt, uptimeMs, node, platform, entry, methods, inflight } without touching the control plane. Use it first when any cube tool times out or returns INTERNAL.

tools.name: cube_health
tools.description: Check control-plane health and CLI version in one call; returns { healthy, exitCode, health:{stdout,stderr,exitCode}, version:{...} }. Use when a sandbox call fails or before starting work.

tools.name: cube_new
tools.description: Create a CubeSandbox with complete metadata. purpose (one short Chinese sentence -> metadata.note), agent (main/sub agent identity -> metadata.agent) and dialogue (conversation ID -> metadata.task) are REQUIRED. Template resolution + creation share a 110s budget (host call limit 120s). Returns { sandboxId, templateId, gatewayUrl, aiodBase, metadata, warnings, stdout, stderr, exitCode }. If it times out, the sandbox may still exist: recover it with cube_ls metadata=task=<ID>.

purpose.description: 沙箱用途：一句简短中文（≤60 字，只写用途，不要写 Agent 名或会话 ID）。写入 metadata.note。

agent.description: 当前平台 Agent 身份（主/子），例如 Cindy(主)、worker-2(子)。

dialogue.description: 当前对话 ID（会话 ID）。写入 metadata.task。

need.description: 所需能力，默认 code；需要浏览器/桌面时分别用 browser/desktop。

timeoutSeconds.description: 空闲回收秒数（不是创建等待时间），默认 1800。

template.description: 直接指定模板 ID 或别名（优先于 need）。

noInternet.description: 为 true 时禁止沙箱出网。

volume.description: 挂载持久卷，格式 卷名 或 卷名:挂载路径。

env.description: 注入沙箱进程的环境变量（键值对，非敏感值）。

tools.name: cube_ls
tools.description: List sandboxes (ID / template / state / note); returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }. Optional metadata filter (e.g. task=<ID>) makes sandbox-to-conversation lookup and leftover cleanup possible.

metadata.description: 按元数据过滤，格式 key=value；多个用逗号分隔，例如 task=bb5c7920-31b6-4ba7-9cf5-96bb2a29d4b1。

state.description: 按状态过滤，例如 running / paused。

limit.description: 返回条数上限（走 v2 接口）。

v2.description: 强制使用 v2 列表接口。

tools.name: cube_rm
tools.description: Destroy a sandbox and stop its processes; returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }. Irreversible. Call it as soon as the task is done.

sandboxId.description: 要销毁的沙箱 ID（可用 cube_ls 查看）。

tools.name: cube_exec
tools.description: Run one shell command inside a sandbox; returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }. The command is passed after `--` as a single argv (no host shell), so quotes, backslashes and leading dashes survive. Sync limit 100s; for longer tasks use cube_submit + cube_log.

command.description: 要执行的 shell 命令，例如 'cd /root/app && npm test'。

timeoutSeconds.description: 沙箱内硬超时秒数，默认且最大 100（宿主单次调用上限 120 秒）；更长任务用 cube_submit。

env.description: 本次命令的额外环境变量（键值对，非敏感值）。

tools.name: cube_code
tools.description: Run a code snippet inside a sandbox through the interpreter (no shell escaping, multi-line safe); returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }. Sync limit 100s; for longer work use cube_submit.

code.description: 要执行的代码原文（可多行）。

timeoutSeconds.description: 沙箱内硬超时秒数，默认且最大 100（宿主单次调用上限 120 秒）。

tools.name: cube_write_file
tools.description: Write a string to a file inside a sandbox (byte-exact, no escaping); returns { path, bytes, exitCode }. Use it to place scripts/configs instead of echoing heredocs.

content.description: 文件内容全文（上限 8 MiB）。

tools.name: cube_read_file
tools.description: Read a file from a sandbox as text; returns { path, content, truncated, exitCode }. Default cap 256 KiB (max 1 MiB); truncated=true means content is incomplete.

maxBytes.description: 最多读取字节数，默认 262144，上限 1048576。

tools.name: cube_run
tools.description: Escape hatch: run any other Cube CLI subcommand (info, ports, logs, pause, resume, connect, timeout, refresh, snap, tpl-*, ls-file, pty-*, raw...); returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }. Sandbox creation and host-file upload are blocked here (use cube_new / cube_write_file); bare --env=NAME is rejected.

args.description: 子命令参数数组（每个 --flag=value 单独一项），例如 ["<sandboxId>"] 或 ["GET", "/health"]。

tools.name: cube_submit
tools.description: Start a long-running control-plane task asynchronously and return { taskId, cmd, status, message } immediately; read it with cube_log. For cmd='new', template resolution and creation run in the background; cube_log returns sandboxId/templateId once the task completes. Poll every 60-90s so the worker is not idle-reclaimed. For long commands inside a sandbox, use cube_run exec-async + exec-logs instead.

cmd.description: 要异步执行的子命令，例如 new、exec、code。

args.description: 子命令参数数组（cmd 不是 new 时使用）。

purpose.description: cmd=new 时必填：一句简短中文用途（≤60 字，只写用途）。写入 metadata.note。

agent.description: cmd=new 时必填：当前平台 Agent 身份，例如 Cindy(主)。

dialogue.description: cmd=new 时必填：当前对话 ID（写入 metadata.task）。

need.description: cmd=new 时的能力需求，默认 code。

timeoutSeconds.description: cmd=new 时的空闲回收秒数，默认 1800。

template.description: cmd=new 时直接指定模板 ID 或别名。

noInternet.description: cmd=new 时为 true 则禁止出网。

volume.description: cmd=new 时挂载持久卷（卷名 或 卷名:挂载路径）。

env.description: cmd=new 时注入的环境变量。

tools.name: cube_log
tools.description: Read logs of a cube_submit task (incremental by offset); returns { taskId, status, completed, exitCode, logs, nextOffset, totalLines }.

offset.description: 从第几行开始读取，缺省从头。

tools.name: cube_kill
tools.description: Terminate a running background task started by cube_submit; returns { taskId, killed }.
